verdict.rationale: Regulatory reporting approval is a fair axis for an AML compliance platform, but the evidence pack never documents submitting regulatory reports (e.g., SARs) externally, nor any approval gate requiring an authorized human sign-off before submission. Case decisions, AI escalation to human review, data exports and case audit trails are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can require an authorized human approval before an externally submitted regulatory report
